objective: Add information from multiple comparable pre-Q laps to the strongest historical Q2 forecast; test a new measurement signal after season-reset rank correction failed.
data_boundary: Only the last completed Practice3 or SprintQualifying before GrandPrixQualifying. Never post-Q practice. Latest session order must be less than target session order. Baseline forecasts, pre-Q raw anchors and complete roster are immutable preceding experiment outputs read with an explicit feature-column allowlist. Current official qualifying labels are opened only after forecast serialization/hash.
lap_filter: Known accurate, green TrackStatus1, no pit-in/out, not explicitly deleted, 30-240 seconds, known session completion clock, known SOFT/MEDIUM/HARD/INTERMEDIATE/WET and tyre age1-6. Within each driver/compound retain laps no slower than1.02 times its clean best, capped to four quickest. Missing deletion metadata is unavailable, not proof a lap was legally undeleted.
matching: For each retained lap, nearest clock lap of every other driver on identical compound within180 seconds and tyre age difference<=2. A lap proposes comparisons only with at least two other drivers. Union unique undirected proposals. Individual driver support requires two matched laps, three distinct peer drivers and comparison graph component>=6 drivers. Full roster remains, unsupported drivers retain Q2 latent score; other drivers moving can change their final rank.
model: Matched lap difference in seconds divided by pre-Q anchor IQR/9.5 (minimum0.02 seconds), minus Q2 prior rank difference in20-car-equivalent positions. Regress on team-indicator differences, driver-indicator differences, common piecewise-linear clock evolution differences and compound-specific observed tyre-age differences. Clock measured in600-second units, hinges at observed pre-Q lap clock quartiles. Compound intercepts cancel by matching. This estimates relative timing differences, not fuel-corrected true pace.
loss: Huber delta3 weighted by0.5*(1/degree_lap_a+1/degree_lap_b) plus quadratic penalties. Team penalty=lambda, driver=4lambda, common clock=0.1, compound-age=2lambda. IRLS maximum60 iterations, coefficient tolerance1e-8; log gradient and iterations. No qualifying labels fit this event-specific measurement model.
uncertainty: Delete each incident lap's comparisons and solve with final robust weights held fixed. Maximum absolute change in each driver's team+driver innovation is a conditional leave-lap-out sensitivity, not a calibrated standard error. Reliability=min(matched_laps/3,1)*min(peer_drivers/5,1)/(1+(sensitivity/2)^2), zero without support. Add strength*reliability*clip(innovation,-5,5) to Q2 latent rank; stable legal permutation with Q2 tie-break. Whole-event fallback is exactly Q2 when no supported drivers or invalid scale.
selection: Four configurations only, chosen by equal-event mean rank MAE on16 eligible2023 events. Ties within1e-12 prefer larger penalty then smaller strength. Serialize lock before reading current2024 targets. Only selected configuration evaluated on24events2024,24events2025,nine2026. No score-informed repairs or further variants.
uncertainty_of_score: 20000 paired event bootstrap and circular three-event block bootstrap,seed20260908,leave-one-event-out ranges. Descriptive retrospective resampling, not posterior or prospective confirmation.
material_success_screen: At least0.15 positions better than Q2 over pooled2024-25 and no2026 regression versus Q1. No production promotion from this retrospective run.
label_blind_support: 2023 mean16.125 supported drivers;2024 15.2083 with one whole-event fallback;2025 16.625;2026 17.7778. These are matching availability counts computed before scoring.
